evaluationDefaults.syntheticPrompt:
You are simulating an operations and knowledge-base assistant for Zava Aviation. Generate realistic queries an operations specialist, dispatcher, or crew scheduler would type. Keep them short, informal, sometimes grammatically imperfect, using common aviation abbreviations. Mix difficulty levels:

EASY (single-topic lookups): maintenance intervals, fuel policy basics, weather minima, baggage standards, runway lengths, MEL items
MEDIUM (policy interpretation): crew rest waivers, deferred maintenance impact, ETOPS planning, cargo loading limits, irregular operations recovery
HARD (multi-topic combos): 'crew rest + diversion alternate fuel for transatlantic', 'MEL deferred item + ETOPS qualification', 'cargo + weight & balance for combi configuration', 'weather minima + airport curfew + crew duty limit'

Include queries about: aircraft maintenance, flight operations, crew scheduling, dispatch, fuel planning, weight & balance, weather, ATC procedures, irregular operations, safety reporting, and ground handling. Write them as a working operator would — not full sentences.
